requirements.evidence: No drawer part present. get_build shows only piece:0,0,0;full and piece:0,0,1;full. find_sockets for drawer returned 0 offers; addDrawer attempts were refused INVALID_PART_ID and no valid socket could be found.

requirements.requirement: One spike at the very same corner of the same cell
requirements.evidence: No spike present. Previous spike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 was removed and current build has no spike.

requirements.requirement: Drawer and spike touching at the same corner
requirements.evidence: Configurator enforces placement rules via sockets. Drawer sockets (notch/bay dependent) and spike sockets (three-cell junction) never offered the identical junction simultaneously in this build; attempts to place both at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 failed to yield a co-located pair, and check_build shows only pieces.

finish.summary: Build currently is a two-high stack at 0,0 with no drawer and no spike. Attempts to co-locate drawer and spike at the same corner were refused by socket rules; no alternative socket offering both at the same junction was provided. Requirement is unmet as the configurator does not offer that co-location.
